stem: What bounds how long or how much work this operation can perform?
notes: Timeouts, deadlines, step limits, retrieval budgets, and retry ceilings are the bound. Recovery after the bound (retry vs circuit) stays out. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0290, FAIL-0132.

stem: What happens when a primary dependency is unavailable?
notes: Unavailable / failover / fallback. Slow-or-erroring cutoffs are slow_cutoff. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0041, CTRL-0058, FAIL-0066, FAIL-0078.

stem: What happens when a dependency becomes too slow or error-prone to keep serving?
notes: Automatic cutoffs and latency-budget degradation. The wait bound itself is bound_work.

stem: What evaluation must pass before this behavior reaches production?
notes: Pre-production gate. Online quality monitoring is not this family. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0196, CTRL-0217, FAIL-0058.

stem: What keeps generated output tied to retrieved or allowed evidence?
notes: Faithfulness / citation. Retrieval ranking quality is retrieval_quality. Review dropped CTRL-0301 as not this diagnostic job. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0152, CTRL-0287, PRIN-0052. Wave-2 review dropped CTRL-0287 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: What happens if this operation runs twice?
notes: Duplicate side effects under retry or at-least-once delivery. Wave-2 attached PRIN-0010, PRIN-0015.

stem: What limits what this principal or tool is allowed to do?
notes: Authorization / least privilege. Identity is authentication. Drift detection is permission_review. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0040, CTRL-0142, CTRL-0161, FAIL-0049, FAIL-0059, FAIL-0101, PRIN-0002, PRIN-0004, PRIN-0056.

stem: How is it detected that permissions have drifted or grown too broad?
notes: Measure/review stance. The permission control itself is permission_boundary.

stem: How is the caller identified before it is authorized?
notes: Authn only. Objects that union authn and authz were left uncited. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0102, CTRL-0136, FAIL-0064. Wave-2 review dropped FAIL-0064 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: What encrypts data while it is in transit?
notes: TLS / in-transit only. At-rest encryption stays separate.

stem: What encrypts data while it is at rest?
notes: At-rest only. Objects that union rest and transit were left uncited. Review dropped CTRL-0098 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: How is unhealthy behavior detected?
notes: Detection/alarm. Presence of logs/traces is telemetry_exist. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0081, CTRL-0158, CTRL-0169. Wave-2 review dropped CTRL-0158 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: What telemetry exists to inspect this operation?
notes: Telemetry presence. Alarms on that telemetry are unhealthy_detect. Review dropped CTRL-0274 as not this diagnostic job. Wave-2 attached PRIN-0053. Wave-3 review attached CTRL-0082, CTRL-0090.

stem: What can grow without bound if this operation is left unconstrained?
notes: Memory, sessions, pools, queues. Work/time budgets are bound_work. Cloud quotas are quota_capacity. Review dropped FAIL-0052, PRIN-0016 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: What capacity or quota is sized so this workload can run without surprise throttling?
notes: Service/cloud quotas. Unbounded agent memory is resource_bound. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0028, CTRL-0043, FAIL-0007, FAIL-0032, FAIL-0047, FAIL-0055, FAIL-0065, FAIL-0071. Wave-2 review dropped FAIL-0065 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: Which actions require a human to approve before they execute?
notes: HITL / multi-party approval. Least privilege is permission_boundary. Review dropped CTRL-0108 as not this diagnostic job. Wave-2 attached CTRL-0047.

stem: What keeps cached or retrieved state from being treated as current when it is not?
notes: Stale TTL / freshness. No matching control was cited in this pass; review may hold or attach one rather than invent a control.

stem: What distinguishes retryable failures from failures that must not be retried?
notes: Split child of QF-0002. Classification only. FAIL-0044 is permission/config errors that will not resolve by retrying. Backoff is QF-0026.

stem: How are retries paced so they do not amplify load during recovery?
notes: Split child of QF-0002. Pacing/jitter/thundering herd only. A retry budget is bound_work.

stem: How is retrieval relevance evaluated?
notes: Split child of QF-0007. Retrieval metrics only. Response faithfulness evaluators stay on grounding/verify, not here. Wave-3 review attached CTRL-0308.

stem: How are agent queries rewritten so retrieval can match the index?
notes: Split child of QF-0007. Singleton: no second uncited object shares this job.

stem: What untrusted content can change this system's instructions or tool use?
notes: Split child of QF-0013. Instruction/tool hijack only. Agent-sec assessment is QF-0031. Wave-2 review dropped FAIL-0128 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: Do security assessments cover agent-specific misuse, not only generic appsec?
notes: Split child of QF-0013. Coverage of agent threats in assessments, not the injection control itself.

stem: What checks untrusted input before it is acted on?
notes: Split child of QF-0014. Input/request checks. Output/tool-error sanitization is QF-0033. Wave-2 review dropped CTRL-0134 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: Are standing credentials used when temporary credentials would suffice?
notes: Split child of QF-0015. Standing vs temporary. Rotation of remaining long-lived secrets is QF-0036.

stem: Where are credentials embedded in the runtime or source tree?
notes: Split child of QF-0015. Singleton: remaining secret objects union storage with encryption or rotation.

stem: How are remaining long-lived credentials rotated?
notes: Split child of QF-0015. Rotation schedule for credentials you still keep. Prefer temporary credentials (QF-0034) first.

stem: How is a behavior change reverted to a known-good baseline?
notes: Split child of QF-0020. Revert/stop-the-experiment. Canary/gradual rollout is QF-0038.

stem: How is a behavior change rolled out gradually rather than all at once?
notes: Split child of QF-0020. Canary/weighted/blue-green. CTRL-0069 also names automatic rollback; that extra stays on the object. Wave-3 review attached CTRL-0103, FAIL-0090.

stem: What change-management record is required before a behavior change ships?
notes: Split child of QF-0020. Singleton: remaining change objects are rollout or rollback, not the record.

stem: What isolates tool or computer-use execution from the agent control plane?
notes: Harness vs sandbox compute, stable sandbox client swap, and computer-use as a security boundary. Least privilege is permission_boundary. Wave-3 review dropped CTRL-0283, CTRL-0285 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: Which tools are available to the agent for this turn?
notes: Singleton: task-relevant catalog vs full-catalog injection. Evaluating whether the agent picked the right tool is tool_selection_eval.

stem: How is it evaluated that the agent selected the right tool for the task?
notes: Singleton: verify stance. The catalog itself is tool_catalog_scope.

stem: How is production output quality monitored after release?
notes: Online eval on production traffic. Pre-production gates are eval_gate. Objects that union offline and online stay uncited.

stem: What labeled examples exist so this behavior can be scored?
notes: Dataset presence. The gate that consumes the dataset is eval_gate.

stem: How is it verified that generated output stayed faithful to retrieved evidence?
notes: Faithfulness evaluators. Exist-stance grounding is QF-0006. Retrieval relevance metrics are retrieval_eval.

stem: Do alerts page only on conditions that need a human now?
notes: Whether the alert set is itself healthy. Detecting unhealthy behavior is QF-0018.

stem: What prevents sensitive data from leaving this system in outputs or downstream handoff?
notes: PII/credential/leak filtering of outputs and reports. XSS encoding, tool-error sanitization, and log injection stay reserved QF-0033 grandchildren. Wave-3 review dropped CTRL-0225 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: How is a session bound to one principal so it cannot be guessed or reused?
notes: Session uniqueness, entropy, and same-session authorization binding. Authn is QF-0012.

stem: How is this system adversarially tested for jailbreak, injection, and extraction after it ships?
notes: Ongoing adversarial exercises. Agent-sec assessment coverage is QF-0031. The injection control itself is QF-0030. Injection-rate metrics stay uncited (measure).

stem: What verifies that a model artifact has not been swapped or bundled with untrusted extras?
notes: Model weights and bundled non-weight artifacts. Generic third-party software is dependency_integrity.

stem: What reuses stable prefixes or prior results so equivalent work is not paid for twice?
notes: Prompt/reasoning cache. Stale-as-current is freshness. Seeing the bill is cost_metering.

stem: What keeps training, evaluation, and retrieved data from leaking into each other?
notes: Train/eval/aux overlap and near-duplicate embeddings across splits. Dataset presence is eval_dataset.

stem: How are datasets, models, and prompts stored so a run can be reproduced without copying blobs into git?
notes: Pointers to versioned blobs. The change-management record before ship is change_tracking.

stem: What playbook exists for this class of incident before it happens?
notes: Prepared response steps. Learning after the incident is postmortem.

stem: What captures incident cause and drill gaps so the next failure is cheaper?
notes: Postmortem template and drill follow-up. The playbook used during the incident is incident_playbook.

stem: What throttles inbound load so a spike cannot exhaust shared resources?
notes: Request throttling placement and adaptiveness. Cloud quota *sizing* is quota_capacity. Work/time budgets are bound_work.

stem: How is it detected that a quota or constraint is being approached?
notes: Detection only. Objects that also auto-request quota increases stay uncited. Quota sizing is quota_capacity.

stem: What metering exists so spend on tokens, inference, or agents can be seen?
notes: Seeing the bill as a continual practice. Right-sizing the pathway is cost_rightsize. Wave-3 review dropped PRIN-0050 as not this diagnostic job.

stem: What confirms third-party or generated dependencies are trusted before they ship?
notes: Trusted, current software components. Model-artifact tampering is model_supply_chain.

stem: How long is monitoring or user data kept, and what deletes it when that period ends?
notes: Singleton: retention and deletion. Consent/opt-out unions stay uncited. Log presence is telemetry_exist; log tamper-resistance is log_integrity.

stem: What enforces a machine-readable shape so downstream code can consume the result?
notes: Required fields / prefilled format. Checking untrusted input is input_validation.

stem: What happens to old API versions and endpoints after a replacement ships?
notes: Leftover weaker endpoints. Authorization of the live API is permission_boundary.
